purpose: Close two predeclared gaps: a strict 54G mirror of the historical 6.12G F3B3A protein-priority route on the native 26,396 delta operational families, and structural follow-up of the five B8R1 original-contig-complete architecture-first ORFs.

branch_A_strict_mirror.family_universe: all 26,396 native delta operational families from the frozen Stage03/MMseqs partition; no OLD/DELTA combined-family novelty filter
branch_A_strict_mirror.selection: exact historical F3B3A four-axis rule: 8 replication, 8 max ORF length, 8 formal-model coverage, 8 motif-C topology, deterministic backfill to 32
branch_A_strict_mirror.structure: Boltz2; MSA server; seed 20261007; recycling 3; sampling 200; diffusion_samples 1; no_kernels; no truncation; no single-sequence fallback
branch_A_strict_mirror.classification: maximum compatibility tier over all returned reference hits; STRONG TM>=0.50,qcov>=0.50,tcov>=0.50; SUGGESTIVE TM>=0.40,qcov>=0.30,tcov>=0.30

branch_B_arch5.source: the five Stage04B8R1 unitig-ABSENT candidates proven complete stop-to-stop on their frozen original source contigs
branch_B_arch5.structure_role: post-B8 technical-completeness extension of the architecture-first DELTA_ONLY arm
branch_B_arch5.negative_interpretation: authorized because all five are original-contig stop-bounded on both sides with zero sequence extension

forbidden: replace the strict-mirror 26,396 native delta family partition with Stage04A combined-family topology
use B5 reclustering as a silent substitute if the frozen native Stage03 family partition is unavailable
call MIXED sequence-space connectivity one-to-one system replication
call an edge-censored architecture candidate a structural negative
